notes: Native generation root-cause fix: the AI engine's native library was built without optimisation, which made the on-device model crawl on this phone - it is now built optimised. Questions asked while the model is loading now wait for the load and are then answered by the AI instead of the built-in brain. Diagnostics now shows prefill and decode times separately for every generation, and records an attempt even if the app process dies mid-generation. Everything else is unchanged (avatars, voice, model, downloads).
